subject.title: [Feature]: Plivo bidirectional audio streaming for realtime voice agents in voice-call

question: Should Plivo realtime streaming be added to the bundled voice-call plugin, or should OpenClaw first establish an external carrier-provider seam for this class of commercial integration?
rationale: Current main has an internal carrier-streaming pattern and an existing bundled voice-call plugin, but VISION.md keeps optional commercial integrations scoped deliberately; source and docs do not establish a settled ownership policy for another carrier.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded bundled Plivo implementation
options.body: Extend the existing voice-call realtime stream adapter for Plivo while preserving the current XML path and requiring carrier-specific security and live-call proof.

options.title: Design an external carrier seam first
options.body: Define and document the required plugin SDK boundary before accepting Plivo so future carrier support does not require modifying bundled voice-call internals.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded bundled Plivo implementation
recommendation.body: Extend the existing voice-call realtime stream adapter for Plivo while preserving the current XML path and requiring carrier-specific security and live-call proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Telnyx realtime-streaming contribution is the closest evidence-backed ownership signal for this carrier adapter boundary.
